scenes.text: A *16-year-old* did *$150K* in sales with ChatGPT and a Walmart run
scenes.say: A sixteen-year-old did one hundred fifty thousand dollars in sales, with ChatGPT and a Walmart run.

scenes.title: Who: *Ethan Alexander*, 16
lines: Kansas City, Missouri. He quit lacrosse and suddenly had time on his hands.
Started May 2025 with $500 left to him by his great-grandfather.
First product: Walmart laundry detergent, resold on Amazon.
scenes.say: Ethan Alexander, sixteen, Kansas City. He started in May twenty twenty-five with five hundred dollars from his great-grandfather, reselling Walmart laundry detergent on Amazon.

scenes.title: The *AI* part
lines: He trained ChatGPT to write Python code that filtered out products that wouldn't sell.
Used AI to track inventory and stay organized.
A seller app showed him fees, stock and the price he needed to profit.
scenes.say: He had ChatGPT write Python code to filter out products that wouldn't sell, and used AI to track his inventory.

scenes.title: The *grind*
lines: Drove 30 to 40 minutes to every big Walmart in the metro, buying out the shelf.
Summer nights packing orders until 5 or 6 a.m.
Then Target, Menards, Home Depot, and pallets stacked in his parents' garage.
scenes.say: Thirty-minute drives to every Walmart in the metro, packing orders until five a.m., then pallets stacked in his parents' garage.

scenes.title: The *numbers*
lines: Biggest day: about $6,000 in sales, roughly $2,000 profit.
Hired virtual assistants to keep up, all while in high school full time.
scenes.say: Ten thousand dollars in sales in month one. His biggest day, about six thousand in sales and two thousand profit.

scenes.label: in sales in *10 months*
scenes.sub: SALES, NOT PROFIT. SOURCE: ENTREPRENEUR, JULY 2026
scenes.say: Ten months in: one hundred fifty thousand dollars in sales. Sales, not profit, per Entrepreneur.

scenes.title: What *now*
lines: He paused the hustle after $150K to focus on school and new projects.
Part of the money goes toward college: business or psychology.
"I just took what was in front of me and made it mine." Entrepreneur, Amanda Breen, July 15, 2026.
scenes.say: He's paused it to focus on school, with part of the money going toward college. His words: I just took what was in front of me, and made it mine.

scenes.text: Want the *ChatGPT filter* he used? Comment *FILTER* and follow.
scenes.say: Want the ChatGPT filter he used? Comment FILTER, and follow for one money move a day.
